% 09.05.2025 [Physical Hearing/Hybrid Hearing (as per request)] CRL.M.A. 12400/2025 (for interim protection)
1. By way of this application, the petitioner seeks interim protection from arrest since the main petition for quashing of the FIR for offence under Section 420 IPC is listed on 02.09.2025.
2. Learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of respondent no.1.
Subject to petitioner taking steps within one week, notice through all modes be also issued to respondent no.2 as well as his counsel.
3. Further, learned ASC submits that the company, which was the victim of the cheating has not been impleaded as a party in this case.
Petitioner is directed to implead the company as a party by filing amended memo of parties within one week along with steps on which notice be issued to the company as well.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/06/2025 at 00:08:53 4.

Learned counsel for petitioner seeks protection till disposal of this petition, contending that petitioner has already paid a sum of Rs. 24,50,000/- to the victim company and the balance settlement amount of Rs. 50,000/- shall be paid before this court on the next date.
5. Considering the submissions, it is directed that till next date, the petitioner shall not be arrested.

6. List on the date already fixed i.e., on 02.09.2025 before the Registrar.
